verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Postman has general team/workspace roles and permissions (postman-docs-14) and a Postman API/CLI with API keys, plus an MCP server gated by API key, but nothing describes creating scoped or least-privilege credentials specifically for an AI agent's use. Missing for 10: documentation of agent-specific API key scoping, granular permission grants tied to an agent identity, or any mention of least-privilege credential issuance for AI agents.
